**Specialist Executive Manager - AI Solutions Architect, Applied AI**

  
  

Deloitte’s Brand, Marketing & Communications (BM&C) organization seeks innovative creatives, strategic marketers, and collaborative leaders to drive business growth and digital transformation. Join a team that blends creativity, business acumen, strategic thinking, and Deloitte’s strong brand equity to deliver impactful marketing solutions. Thrive in a diverse, supportive environment where you leverage cultural trends, emerging technologies, and bold ideas to challenge the status quo. Be part of Deloitte’s journey to turn visionary concepts into marketing success.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an AI Technical Architect to determine how best to build agents on our internal agentic AI platform to deliver specific business outcomes. This role will have shared collaboration and responsibility in what each agent does and how well it does it: the design approach, model choice, context and prompting, agent behavior, and output quality.

Working with business stakeholders to define the outcomes that matter, and directly with our engineering pods, this person accelerates development by moving ideas from concept to testable prototype, and sets the quality bar for the agents our team delivers to BM&C.

Role reports into AI & Innovation Leader in the US. Will be working closely with the Senior Manager and daily with the technical leads and engineering pods. This role will partner with the Data and AI Manager, the AI Data and Analytics Engineer, along with the Risk Teams.

**Work you'll do**

As a Specialist Executive Manager - AI Solutions Architect, Applied AI on the Brand, Marketing & Communications team, you will be responsible for…

Key Responsibilities

* Outcome-driven solution design: Work with business stakeholders to translate specific outcomes into agent and platform design. Scope the problem, define success metrics up front, and choose the right approach (single agent, multi-agent, workflow, or no agent at all), including build, buy, or configure decisions. The senior manager and team lead sets priorities; this role decides how best to build, together with the pod technical leads.
* Prototyping and proofs of concept: Rapidly prototype new capabilities so ideas move from concept to something testable.
* Advanced agent development: Build or co-build the most demanding agents with the engineering pods, owning their design, prompting, instructions, grounding, and tool use.
* Agent quality ownership: Serve as the single accountable owner for the quality of team-built agents, with authority to gate release, maintain clear quality roles and responsibilities, and turn subject-matter expert criteria (brand, communications, and others) into evaluation suites: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scoring, human review, and regression tests run whenever a model or prompt changes. Share one metric set with the AI Data & Analytics Engineer, who measures value in production.
* Agent design standards: Set best practices for context engineering, prompting, golden-prompt standards, and agent patterns, including when an agent is not the right answer.
* Model and tool strategy: Define the model and tool portfolio and its selection criteria across Gemini, Adobe, and external vendors (including other model families such as Claude and OpenAI), with documented rationale on quality, cost, latency, and risk. Select the model for each agent within that portfolio, backed by comparative evaluations.
* Platform and vendor intelligence: Track and test new Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI, Adobe, and Google features, and evaluate external AI tools, standards, and models for fit with our stack, recommending what to adopt or retire.
* Data and retrieval partnership: Partner with the AI Data & Analytics Engineer and the data manager so agents are grounded in modeled, governed data. Own the retrieval and grounding design for each agent; pod technical leads own the integration build.
* Governance and responsible AI: Partner with pod technical leads and risk teams on guardrails, data privacy, access controls, and brand and compliance safeguards. Design agents for observability, cost, and latency, with the pods owning implementation and operation.

Team Management:

* Oversee talent acquisition, performance management, and professional development for the digital marketing organization.
* Provide advanced performance coaching and regular feedback to managers and team members.
* Inspire, coach, and mentor managers and team members, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and excellence.
* Maintain a strong team management presence, upward management, problem-solving, and handling difficult conversations.
* Optimize resource allocation and resolve high-level challenges.
* Lead cross-functional collaboration and strategic partnerships across business units and global teams.

**The team**

The Brand, Marketing & Communications (BM&C) organization brings together marketing, brand, communications, data, technology, and innovation capabilities to help Deloitte advance business priorities and create connected, measurable audience experiences. This team is building an AI-enabled marketing foundation that combines data, analytics, and agentic AI to improve decision-making, operational effectiveness, and campaign performance. The individual will be responsible for managing the complete project lifecycle, from pre-construction planning, design coordination, and project development through construction execution, commissioning, and final handover.

This is a senior leadership position requiring extensive expertise in commercial construction, project planning, cost management, technical coordination, and stakeholder management. The selected candidate will lead large construction teams, manage reputed Project Management Consultants (PMCs), coordinate with architects and specialised design consultants, and oversee contractors to ensure successful project delivery within approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and specifications.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Project Leadership & End-to-End Execution**

* Lead the complete project lifecycle, from pre-construction planning and design development to construction, commissioning, and final handover.
* Develop comprehensive project execution strategies, construction methodologies, master schedules, and resource deployment plans.
* Take complete ownership of project delivery, ensuring adherence to approved timelines, budgets, quality benchmarks, and technical specifications.
* Drive the execution of large-scale commercial developments, including high-rise structures and premium commercial buildings.
* Establish effective project governance mechanisms, reporting structures, review systems, and execution controls.
* Monitor overall project progress and ensure timely resolution of critical execution challenges.

### **2. PMC & Consultant Management**

* Lead and manage reputed Project Management Consultants (PMCs), ensuring accountability for project monitoring, coordination, and delivery.
* Oversee coordination with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, façade consultants, and other technical stakeholders.
* Review PMC deliverables, project schedules, progress reports, technical submissions, and quality benchmarks.
* Ensure seamless coordination between design consultants, contractors, internal departments, and project stakeholders.
* Evaluate technical recommendations, identify execution gaps, and drive timely resolution of project-level issues.
* Establish clear responsibilities and performance expectations across PMC and consultant teams.

### **3. Construction & Technical Management**

* Oversee civil, structural, reinforced cement concrete (RCC), MEP, façade, finishing, waterproofing, firefighting, HVAC, electrical, and allied construction activities.
* Review and approve construction methodologies, technical specifications, drawings, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), and material submissions within delegated authority.
* Ensure construction activities comply with approved architectural and structural drawings, engineering standards, and project specifications.
* Monitor site progress through regular inspections, technical reviews, and coordination meetings.
* Ensure effective integration and sequencing of civil, structural, MEP, façade, and finishing activities.
* Identify technical and execution-related risks and implement appropriate corrective measures.

We’re currently looking for a high caliber professional to join our team as **Assistant Vice President, Business Analytics Sr Analyst - Hybrid** (C12) based in India/KL. * Develop, maintain, and enhance analytical reports, dashboards, and management information tools.

* Produce recurring and ad hoc reporting for management and regulatory requirements.

* Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines, ETL processes, and analytical workflows.

* Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate resolution with technology partners.

* Support the development and implementation of fraud detection and monitoring solutions.

* Perform root cause analysis for control breaches, report failures, and production incidents.
* Contribute to Corrective Action Plan (CAP) and audit remediation activities.

* Participate in end-to-end project delivery including requirements gathering, design, testing, implementation, and post-production support.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders across APAC, EMEA, and NAM regions.

* Maintain documentation to support audit and regulatory reviews.

* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.
* Experience with Pyspark, Python, Spark, Hadoop, or similar big data technologies.
* Knowledge of reporting and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent.
* Proficient in Agile toolkits: Jira, Github and Confluence
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: Program Manager
description:
The MongoDB Customer Organization Portfolio Management Office (PMO) orchestrates strategic initiatives and programs that advance customer experience, functional excellence, and technology innovation. Through comprehensive portfolio governance, the PMO optimizes investments and drives value realization across MDB's Customer priorities to accelerate enterprise growth and enable customer success.

As trusted advisors to leadership, the PMO implements data-driven frameworks that strengthen decision-making and cross-functional alignment of our most business-critical initiatives. This systematic approach to benefit tracking and resource optimization positions MongoDB to capture emerging market opportunities, maximize stakeholder value, and set new industry benchmarks.

### **About The Role**

As "Program Manager, Customer Strategy & Operations" you'll play a critical role as part of our PMO in the scaling of our Customer Organization.

In this role, you'll be the driving force behind a portfolio of programs and strategic initiatives, each aimed at realizing customer value, optimizing our operations, and advancing our capabilities. You'll thrive on complexity and make swift, thoughtful, data-driven decisions that balance outcomes across the function and our customer org. Your ability to anticipate obstacles, work through developing problem spaces, influence cross-functional alignment, and realize strategic outcomes will be crucial in maximizing our collective impact.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. The working model for this role can be in office (3 days a week) or flexible (2 days a week).

### **The ideal candidate will:**

* Be a Leader: Driven by an attuned sense of priority and urgency to deliver on the right things at the right time. Orchestrate multiple, interconnected projects, programs, and portfolios to maximize long term benefits. Drive high-level decision-making that aligns program objectives with organizational goals and customer needs
* Own the Strategy: Establish the strategic vision and maintain comprehensive governance structures for your programs. Oversee all plans, timelines, and resources to ensure cohesive delivery across the entire portfolio
* #BuildTogether: Build credibility and earn trust in all your interactions. Lead your teams, stakeholders organizations toward simple, coherent approaches. Facilitate high-level communications and strategic forums to align your programs and portfolio across all organizational levels
* Have a knack for looking around corners: Recognize patterns in a sea of information and take action accordingly. Anticipate program-wide risks and opportunities. Develop strategies to mitigate issues across multiple projects and programs, manage interdependencies, and capitalize on synergies within the portfolio
* Follow the data: Understand how data contributes to better story telling. Devise compelling program-wide metrics and analytics frameworks. Leverage cross-program data to inform strategic decision-making and drive continuous improvement across the entire portfolio
* Detest surprises: Sweep nothing under the rug. Establish clear program objectives, scope, deliverables, and roadmaps in partnership with senior leadership and key stakeholders that account for dependencies, constraints, and conflicts. Ensure alignment between individual programs and overarching portfolio goals
* Live in the future: Take a long term position in all that you do and help others see the big picture. Develop long-term program strategies that anticipate evolving business needs. Implement scalable frameworks and best practices that elevate program management capabilities across the organization
* Be a good human: Leave your ego at the door. Model accountability and create the structures that help cultivate it in others. Provide mentorship and guidance to teams across your programs. Foster a culture of ownership, integrity, and collaboration that spans multiple teams and departments

### **Requirements**

* Experience: At least 5+ years in a program or portfolio management role overseeing a portfolio of complex, interdependent programs in a technical environment. Proven track record of delivering strategic outcomes through multi-program initiatives across various methodologies
* Communication & Consensus: Exceptional ability to articulate program vision, status, and impact to diverse audiences. Orchestrate collaboration between senior leaders, cross-functional teams, and external stakeholders to ensure program outcomes align with organizational strategy and customer needs. Skilled at influencing without authority and facilitating high-level strategic discussions to drive results
* Adaptability: Navigate complex, evolving program landscapes. Ability to pivot program direction in response to changing business priorities while maintaining overall strategic alignment across the portfolio
* Improvement: Implement program-wide continuous improvement initiatives. Foster a culture of innovation and efficiency across multiple programs and portfolio teams
* Optimization: Develop and execute strategies for optimal resource allocation across the program portfolio. Balance competing priorities and interdependencies to maximize overall program impact
* Change: Lead large-scale organizational and structural changes through strategic program and portfolio initiatives. Ensure smooth adoption of new processes, tools, or methodologies across multiple teams and departments

### **Success Measures**

* In 3 months you will have gained a comprehensive understanding of MongoDB's ecosystem, fully integrated into Customer and PMO processes, and begun developing a strategic roadmap for your programs and portfolio
* In 6 months you'll have established robust program governance structures, aligned multiple projects and programs with our organizational goals, and demonstrated initial strategic impact across your portfolio
* In 9 months you'll have identified opportunities for program-wide operational improvements, built consensus among senior stakeholders for these initiatives, and begun implementing changes that enhance overall program and portfolio effectiveness to materialize organizational value

### **What's In It For You**

* Mentorship & Career Growth: Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we celebrate knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to help you achieve your goals
* Work-Life Harmony: Our team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that benefits both parts of your life. We offer flexibility and encourage you to find your own balance
* Empowerment & Autonomy: Our team believes in empowering you to #OwnWhatYouDo and #MakeItMatter. You'll receive the support you need to achieve a high level of independence
* Location & Flexibility: MongoDB provides multiple working model options for our employees, including the flexibility to work from home to opportunities for collaboration and social interaction in a MongoDB office. These working models may be dependent on specific roles and are mutually agreed upon between employees and their managers
* Generous compensation package: MongoDB believes in the value our employees add to the company and we pay in the top 95th percentile. Salary is just one part of MongoDB's total compensation and benefits package. Other benefits for eligible employees may include: equity, participation in the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks fully-paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, 401(k) plan, mental health counseling, access to transgender-inclusive health insurance coverage, and health benefits offerings. Compensation at the time of offer is unique to each candidate based on a variety of factors such as skill set, experience, qualifications, and work location

### **Should I apply?**

If you're passionate about building things for the long term, are eager to learn, and willing to tackle new challenges, we encourage you to apply – even if you don't meet all the criteria listed. We value diversity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds.

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

description:
**AI/ML Intern**

**Location:** Bengaluru (Onsite)
  
**Duration:** Semester Internship (Full-Time)
  
**Company:** London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG)

  

**Role Overview**

**At LSEG, we are building AI solutions that help teams solve complex operational and business challenges. We are looking for an AI/ML Intern who is excited to learn, experiment, and apply machine learning and generative AI in a business environment.**

As part of our Innovation & Intelligence team, you will work with data scientists, engineers, and business teams to develop solutions using machine learning, information retrieval, and generative AI technologies. You will contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from research and prototyping to deployment and performance improvement.

We value curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning. Whether you have gained experience through academic projects, research, hackathons, or personal work, we encourage you to apply and bring your ideas to the team.

**About the Team**

We apply data science, artificial intelligence, and automation to improve how work gets done across LSEG. Our team partners with business and technology teams to deliver practical solutions that improve efficiency, support decision-making, and enhance customer outcomes.

We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives. Everyone on the team is encouraged to share ideas, ask questions, and contribute to solving real-world problems.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

As an AI/ML Intern, you will:

* Develop and improve machine learning and AI solutions that address real business challenges.
* Build and maintain data processing and machine learning pipelines.
* Evaluate emerging machine learning and generative AI approaches and apply them where appropriate.
* Analyse data and identify opportunities to improve model performance and business outcomes.
* Create prototypes to test ideas and validate approaches.
* Work with engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions.
* Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving sessions.
* Document findings and share knowledge with the wider team.
* Support deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement activities.

**Professional Skills**

We are looking for someone who:

* Enjoys solving problems and working with data.
* Is curious and open to learning new tools, technologies, and ways of working.
* Communicates ideas clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Works well with others and values different perspectives.
* Takes ownership of assigned work and follows through on commitments.
* Can adapt to changing priorities and learn quickly in a dynamic environment.

**What You Will Gain**

During your internship, you will have the opportunity to:

  
  

**Work on Real Business Challenges**

Contribute to AI and machine learning projects that support operational and strategic decisions across a global organisation.

  
  

**Learn from Experienced Practitioners**

Work alongside data scientists, engineers, and business professionals who will provide guidance, feedback, and mentorship throughout the internship.

  
  

**Build Practical Skills**

Gain hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks, generative AI platforms, software engineering practices, and cloud technologies.

  
  

**Grow Your Professional Network**

Collaborate with teams across LSEG and build relationships with colleagues from different disciplines and backgrounds.

  
  

**Explore Future Opportunities**

Successful interns may be considered for future opportunities within LSEG based on performance and business needs.

  
  

**Inclusion at LSEG**

At LSEG, we know that people bring different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

If you do not meet every requirement listed in this description, we still encourage you to apply. Research shows that some candidates are less likely to apply unless they meet every qualification. We are interested in your potential, your willingness to learn, and how you can contribute.

If you require adjustments or accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates.

  

**Career Stage:**

Associate  
  
  

**LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.**

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.

  
  

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

  

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.

  
  

Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.

  

Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.

This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

  
  

Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject .

  

By clicking on "Apply", the process for submitting an application will begin. If you have any questions prior to clicking "Apply", please contact the recruiter.

  
  

If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.

description:
**Company Description** Nabhya Ayurveda is dedicated to promoting health from within, rooted in classical Ayurvedic principles. The brand centers its philosophy around the Nabhi (belly button), considered in Ayurveda as the body’s core, closely linked to digestion, metabolism, immunity, and overall balance. In a modern world where traditional wisdom is often overlooked, Nabhya Ayurveda focuses on reviving and applying these age-old insights in a contemporary, accessible way. Team members work in an environment that blends holistic wellness, scientific understanding, and customer-centered product innovation. Applicants can expect a mission-driven culture that values authenticity, learning, and a deep respect for Ayurveda.

**About the role**

About **70% of the role is recruiting**: finding, attracting and closing strong performance marketers, creative strategists, video editors, marketplace and retention specialists. The other 30% is running the floor: people operations, HRMS, attendance, onboarding, and keeping the team engaged and accountable.

You’ll report directly to the founder.

**What you’ll do**

***Recruitment (your main focus)***

* Own hiring end to end: work out what each role needs with the founder, write sharp job descriptions, source, screen, coordinate interviews, close offers and make sure people actually join
* Know where good talent is for each role, beyond job portals: LinkedIn, D2C and marketing communities, Instagram and Behance for creative roles, referrals, colleges and freelancer networks
* Build a pipeline of candidates before roles open, not after
* Run structured screening with role-specific questions, practical tasks and scorecards, so we hire on proof of work rather than résumés
* Negotiate offers, manage notice periods, and keep candidates engaged until they join
* Manage recruitment agencies and job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Instahyre, etc.) and track how much each source costs and what it delivers
* Build our employer brand: careers page, LinkedIn presence, and making candidates want to work here

***People operations & floor management***

* Run day-to-day floor management: attendance, discipline, leave, and making sure the office runs smoothly
* Own our HRMS (Keka, Zoho People, GreytHR or similar): employee records, attendance, leave and payroll inputs
* Coordinate monthly payroll with finance/CA and handle PF, ESIC and statutory compliance
* Run onboarding so every new hire is productive in their first week, and run exit processes properly
* Set up basic HR policies, an employee handbook and appraisal cycles as we grow
* Be the first point of contact for employee concerns, resolve conflicts early, and keep morale and retention high

**Who you are**

* **3–6 years in HR**, with most of it in recruitment
* **You’ve scaled a team before**, ideally helping a startup or D2C brand grow from a small team to 50–100+ people
* You’ve hired for **marketing, creative or e-commerce roles** and know what good looks like in them
* You know where to find talent for each kind of role, and you have a network to start with
* Hands-on with at least one HRMS, and comfortable with payroll inputs and Indian statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, PT)
* Firm but approachable on the floor. People respect you and come to you
* Fast and organised: you can run 6+ open roles at once without dropping any
* Strong communication in English and Hindi

**Bonus**

* Experience at a D2C, FMCG, e-commerce or consumer brand
* Experience setting up HR systems from scratch (policies, appraisals, handbook)
* A strong LinkedIn presence and recruiter network

**What we offer**

* **Competitive pay based on your experience and track record**
* Direct reporting to the founder: real authority, fast decisions, no layers
* The chance to build a company’s team from the ground up
* A clear path to Head of People as we scale

Pay: ₹900,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

* Paid time off

* Are you comfortable working from our office in Malad east , Mumbai , Monday to Alt. Saturday , 10am to 7pm ?

description:
**SOVOS**

**Senior Integration Engineer - Boomi**
=======================================

Business Systems·Full-Time·Navi Mumbai

**Build Your Future With Us**

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

**THE ROLE**

At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. As a Senior Integration Engineer, you'll own mission-critical Boomi integrations that power our order-to-cash processes, connect closed systems to modern workflows, and enable AI agents to interact safely with internal and external APIs. This is high-visibility engineering with a direct line to business impact.

*More specifically, you will:*

* Own and maintain Boomi integrations that turn Salesforce orders into NetSuite sales orders, invoices, and billing records, including usage and overage billing flows.
* Run integrations in production - monitor, alert on, and recover from failures, act as the escalation point when something breaks, and keep clear written runbooks.
* Lead authentication and credential work, such as OAuth migrations, certificate rotation, and service-user design.
* Fix and harden data-quality issues across the CRM-to-ERP flow, including payment terms, addresses, and sync-back of IDs.
* Design and build new Boomi integrations from requirements to deployment when the business needs them, and bring data in from closed systems that lack native connectors, APIs, or modern data interfaces.
* Turn internal product APIs into MCP servers that AI agents can use reliably and securely, exposing Sovos systems to agents as safe, well-described tools.
* Leverage AI-assisted tooling (for example, Boomi Companion) to troubleshoot, build, and document integrations faster, with your own review and tests, and assess new integration and agent platforms with evidence-based recommendations.

**Company Description**

***Colliers (NASDAQ, TSX: CIGI) is a global diversified professional services and investment management company operating through three industry-leading businesses: Commercial Real Estate, Engineering and Investment Management. With greater than a 30-year track record of consistent growth and strong recurring cash flows, we scale complementary, high-value businesses that provide essential services across the full asset lifecycle. Our unique partnership philosophy empowers exceptional leaders, preserves our entrepreneurial culture, and ensures meaningful insider ownership, driving strong alignment and sustained value creation for our shareholders. With $6.1billion in annual revenues, 28,000 professionals, and $110 billion in assets under management, Colliers is committed to accelerating the success of our clients, investors, and people worldwide. Learn more at*** ***corporate.colliers.com******.***

 **Job Description**

The Associate Director - Technical is responsible for leading the technical operations of large IFM portfolios, ensuring efficient management of engineering services, compliance, asset reliability, energy optimization, and technical governance across multiple sites. The role oversees technical teams, client relationships, P&L performance, and strategic initiatives while ensuring operational excellence and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Operations Leadership

* Lead technical operations across multiple client accounts and locations.
* Ensure uninterrupted operation of critical engineering infrastructure.
* Oversee maintenance of MEP systems, including:
  + Electrical Systems
  + HVAC Systems
  + DG Sets
  + UPS Systems
  + Fire & Life Safety Systems
  + STP/WTP Plants
  + Building Management Systems (BMS)
  + Elevators & Escalators
* Drive preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance programs.

2. Strategic Account Management

* Act as the technical advisor to key client stakeholders.
* Participate in quarterly and annual business reviews.
* Support account growth, client retention, and contract renewals.
* Develop technical solutions aligned with client business requirements.
* Manage escalation and critical incident resolution.

3. Technical Governance & Compliance

* Ensure compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Drive adherence to:
  + Electrical Safety Standards
  + Fire Safety Regulations
  + EHS Policies
  + ISO 9001, ISO 14001 & ISO 45001 Standards
* Conduct technical audits and risk assessments.
* Ensure business continuity and disaster recovery readiness.

4. Financial & Commercial Management

* Own technical budget planning and expenditure management.
* Monitor technical P&L, cost optimization, and productivity initiatives.
* Develop annual maintenance budgets and capital expenditure plans.
* Evaluate and manage technical contracts and AMCs.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities through operational efficiencies.

5. Asset & Reliability Management

* Develop asset lifecycle management strategies.
* Monitor asset performance, reliability, and maintenance costs.
* Lead major equipment replacement and modernization initiatives.
* Implement reliability-centered maintenance practices.
* Drive adoption of CAFM and digital maintenance systems.

6. Energy & Sustainability Management

* Lead energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives.
* Monitor utility consumption and energy performance indicators.
* Drive implementation of:
  + Energy Audits
  + Water Conservation Programs
  + Carbon Reduction Initiatives
  + Green Building Practices
* Support LEED, IGBC, and WELL certification requirements where applicable.

7. Team Leadership & Development

* Lead Regional Technical Managers, Chief Engineers, and Site Engineering Teams.
* Establish performance objectives and development plans.
* Conduct technical training and succession planning.
* Drive a culture of safety, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Support recruitment and workforce planning for technical functions.

8. Project Management

* Manage fit-out projects, CAPEX projects, refurbishments, and technical upgrades.
* Review project plans, budgets, and timelines.
* Ensure successful project execution with minimal operational disruption.
* Coordinate with consultants, contractors, and vendors.

9. Vendor Management

* Evaluate technical vendors and service partners.
* Monitor contractor performance and SLA adherence.
* Negotiate technical service contracts and procurement requirements.
* Conduct periodic vendor audits and reviews.

  
**Qualifications**

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline

 **Additional Information**  

* Technical SLA Compliance
* System Uptime & Reliability
* Client Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
* Energy Cost Reduction
* EHS Compliance Score
* Preventive Maintenance Completion Rate
* Budget & P&L Achievement
* Asset Lifecycle Performance
* Technical Audit Compliance
* Team Productivity & Retention

title: TA Manager
description:
A. Job Summary

The Talent Acquisition Manager will be responsible for developing, managing, and executing the organization’s overall talent acquisition strategy to ensure the timely hiring of qualified candidates across all business functions and locations. The role involves overseeing the complete recruitment lifecycle, managing recruitment teams and external hiring partners, strengthening employer branding, and ensuring that recruitment activities are aligned with the organization’s business objectives and manpower requirements.

The individual will be responsible for driving recruitment efficiency, maintaining hiring quality, optimizing recruitment costs, and ensuring a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process.

B. Key Responsibilities

The Employee shall perform the duties of Talent Acquisition Manager and will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following:

1. Recruitment Strategy & Workforce Planning

Develop and implement comprehensive talent acquisition strategies aligned with the organization’s business goals, expansion plans, and manpower requirements. Prepare recruitment plans, hiring forecasts, and sourcing strategies to ensure timely availability of talent across departments and business locations.

2. End-to-End Recruitment Management

Oversee and manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, including manpower requisitions, job descriptions, candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, selection, salary negotiations, offer release, offer follow-ups, and onboarding coordination. Ensure timely closure of open positions while maintaining hiring quality.

3. Stakeholder Management & Coordination

Work closely with business heads, department managers, operational teams, and HR stakeholders to understand manpower requirements, finalize hiring priorities, and establish recruitment timelines. Maintain regular communication with stakeholders regarding hiring progress, challenges, and pending requirements.

4. Employer Branding & Talent Pipeline Development

Strengthen the organization’s employer brand through job portals, social media platforms, employee referrals, recruitment campaigns, campus hiring, and other relevant channels. Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future organizational requirements.

5. Recruitment Team Management & Leadership

Lead, manage, mentor, and guide the Talent Acquisition team to achieve individual and organizational hiring targets. Allocate recruitment responsibilities, monitor team performance, review recruitment productivity, and ensure adherence to established recruitment processes and quality standards.

6. Recruitment Agency & Job Portal Management

Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and manage relationships with recruitment agencies, consultants, job portals, and other hiring partners. Monitor vendor performance, recruitment costs, candidate quality, and service delivery to ensure cost-effective hiring solutions.

7. Recruitment MIS, Analytics & Performance Monitoring

Maintain accurate recruitment MIS and dashboards covering open positions, closures, pending requirements, sourcing channels, interview-to-selection ratios, offer-to-joining ratios, time-to-hire, cost-per-hire, and other relevant recruitment metrics. Submit periodic recruitment reports to management and recommend corrective actions wherever required.

8. Recruitment Process & Quality Management

Establish standardized recruitment procedures, screening guidelines, interview frameworks, selection criteria, and candidate evaluation processes. Ensure consistency in hiring practices, improve recruitment turnaround time, and maintain the quality of candidates selected.

9. Offer Management & Candidate Engagement

Oversee salary discussions, offer approvals, offer releases, candidate follow-ups, and joining confirmations. Develop effective engagement strategies to minimize offer dropouts, improve joining ratios, and ensure a professional candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.

10.Recruitment Budget & Cost Optimization

Plan and monitor the recruitment budget, manage sourcing expenditure, evaluate hiring channel effectiveness, and identify opportunities to reduce recruitment costs without compromising the quality of talent acquired.

11.Recruitment Compliance & Documentation

Ensure that all recruitment activities are conducted in accordance with company policies, internal approval procedures, and applicable statutory and legal requirements. Maintain accurate records of candidate details, interview feedback, selection approvals, offer documentation, and recruitment-related documents.

12.Process Improvement & Technology Implementation

Continuously evaluate and improve recruitment processes, sourcing strategies, tools, and technologies. Identify opportunities to implement automation, improve recruitment tracking systems, and enhance overall hiring efficiency and candidate experience.

13.Additional Responsibilities

Perform any other duties, responsibilities, or assignments as may be entrusted by the management from time to time, in line with the employee’s designation, capabilities, and organizational requirements.

Pay: ₹65,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

* Maintain a high level of confidentiality.

* Support testing and roll-out of system enhancements.
* Identify recurring inquiries and process pain points, and recommend or build improvements (job aids, templates, automation) that help the team scale.
* Complete tasks assigned by leadership with a sense of urgency and confidentiality where needed.

* HR Management System/HR Information System experience (Workday preferred).

**Job Title:** Education Counsellor  
**Department:** Admissions  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 2 Years  
**Job Location:** Dr. M.G.R. Nagar, Perandapalli, Tamil Nadu – 635130  
**Languages Required:** Tamil, English, and Hindi

About the Institution

Adhiyamaan College of Engineering is an engineering education institution committed to academic excellence and student development. We aim to help students identify suitable academic programmes and make informed decisions about their higher education and career opportunities.

We are looking for a motivated and experienced Education Counsellor to join our Admissions Team and support student recruitment and admission activities.

Job Summary

The Education Counsellor will be responsible for handling student enquiries, counselling students and parents regarding engineering and other academic programmes, explaining admission procedures, and converting prospective student enquiries into confirmed admissions. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a professional approach, and experience in educational counselling or college admissions.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle student and parent enquiries through phone calls, WhatsApp, email, website enquiries, and walk-in visits.
* Explain available courses, specializations, eligibility criteria, fee structures, scholarships (where applicable), and admission procedures.
* Counsel students and parents regarding engineering programmes, higher education opportunities, and career prospects.
* Follow up with prospective students regularly to encourage applications and improve admission conversion rates.
* Manage and update student enquiry databases using CRM software, MS Excel, or admission management systems.
* Assist students with application forms, document submission, eligibility verification, and admission formalities.
* Coordinate with the Admissions Department and other relevant departments to ensure a smooth admission process.
* Communicate professionally with students, parents, educational consultants, and school representatives.
* Support admission campaigns, school visits, career guidance programmes, education fairs, seminars, and promotional events.
* Maintain accurate records of enquiries, follow-ups, applications, and confirmed admissions.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly admission performance reports for the reporting manager.
* Work towards individual and team admission targets within the prescribed timelines.
* Provide timely updates to students regarding application status, required documents, and admission deadlines.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of student information and admission records.

Eligibility Criteria

* Any undergraduate degree from a recognized university.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in education counselling, student admissions, or a related field.
* Experience in engineering college admissions or higher education counselling will be an added advantage.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in Tamil and English is preferred.
* Basic computer skills, including MS Excel, email, and online enquiry management.
* Ability to manage multiple enquiries, conduct consistent follow-ups, and work towards admission targets.

Required Skills

* Student counselling and parent communication
* Engineering college admission procedures
* Lead management and enquiry conversion
* Telephone, WhatsApp, and email communication
* CRM and admission database management
* MS Excel and report preparation
* Student relationship management
* Time management and organizational skills
* Team coordination and problem-solving
* Target-oriented working approach

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be proactive, student-focused, and capable of building positive relationships with students and parents. Candidates with previous experience in engineering colleges, universities, educational institutions, admission offices, or education consultancy firms are encouraged to apply.

Salary and Benefits

* Salary: As per experience and institutional norms.
* Employment Type: Full-Time.
* Opportunity to work with the college admissions team.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.

Tamil Nadu – 635130.

Interested candidates who meet the above requirements are invited to apply through Indeed with their updated resume, relevant work experience, and contact details.

**In this role, you will:**

  

* Manage and develop a team of Business Execution Consultants while ensuring successful planning, integration, impasse resolution, and measurement of operations with moderate to high complexity and visibility
* Engage functional leaders to obtain resources, influence outcomes, address conflict, and ensure alignment with Wells Fargo's policies and business line objectives
* Identify potential risks when implementing change along with developing mitigation strategies and plans
* Recommend opportunities for Business Execution process improvement
* Determine appropriate strategies and actions of multiple business groups to meet moderate to high complex deliverables
* Interpret procedures and processes, and provide leadership to strategize and execute a variety of programs, services, and initiatives that are significant in scope, complexity, and risk
* Collaborate with and influence functional business partners, leaders, and executive management to provide support and drive strategic initiatives for the business
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for Business Execution
* Develop and guide a culture of talent development to meet business objectives and strategy

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 3+ years Management or leadership experience

**Desired Qualifications:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in model governance of front office pricing models across multiple asset classes
* 5+ years of experience in model validation of front office and risk models
* 5+ years of model development experience for front office or Risk applications.
* Excellent understanding of quantitative modeling in several asset classes.
* Solid experience with risk modeling: VaR, PFE, backtesting, Capital calculations.
* 4+ years of management experience at the relevant level with direct reports responsible for annual reviews, employee production, staffing and recruitment
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical
* audiences

Job Details

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.

You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won’t fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills from a technology perspective, including a foundational understanding of how to leverage AI development tools to optimize delivery cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer’s growth plans seamlessly. * Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)

* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Lead a technical team and own customer and team engagement
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%
* Maintain a target billable utilisation aligned to the role

* Maintain billable utilisation targets for your team

* Working with global teams for delivery across geographies. We will need you to be flexible with your work hours
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire
* Leader of Leaders
* Experience building & growing a practice
* Must have managed a team of technical & solution implementors

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life.
